'''Janissa's private estate''' was a residence maintained by the [[Holovid/Legends|holovid]] [[Actor/Legends|actress]] [[Janissa Locrin]].<ref name="GG11" /> At one point by approximately [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]],<ref name="GG11date">''[[Galaxy Guide 11: Criminal Organizations]]'', including "[[They Said It Couldn't Be Done]]," is set around six [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the events of {{Film|VI}}, which corresponds to approximately [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]] per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> the [[Karazak Slavers' Cooperative/Legends|Karazak Slavers' Cooperative]] kidnapped Locrin from the estate.<ref name="GG11" />
